articles.title: Bullish beats revenue estimates as institutional services offset sluggish spot crypto volumes
articles.snippet: Bullish’s institutional focus may have shielded the company from the decline in activity experienced by rivals catering to retail traders and offers some insight to its revenue beat.

articles.title: XRP whales moved $270 million during the selloff. The coins didn’t go to exchanges
articles.snippet: A holder whose wallets trace back to a 2020 Bitstamp withdrawal has moved 281 million XRP into two vaults three weeks apart, a behavior indicative of custody rather than a large investor heading for the exit.

articles.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
articles.snippet: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

articles.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
articles.snippet: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

articles.title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.
